scope: Local implementation and offline loopback regression tests

commit_record.user_decision: Commit locally and keep records; do not deploy.

covered: Global proxy changes reach model, streaming and MCP requests without rebuilding the provider
Same proxy address with new password or username uses updated proxy authentication
Enable and clear global proxy while preserving credential proxy and direct overrides
In-flight response completes after switching subsequent requests to a new proxy
Retry uses the proxy selected after a failed previous attempt
Cache eviction remains bounded when credential proxies become global, former global proxies become evictable and global proxy is cleared
boundaries: Tests used loopback HTTP stubs and synthetic credentials, not real accounts or proxies.
No production HTTPS CONNECT, SOCKS5/SOCKS5h or billing validation was performed.
In-flight attempts retain their current connection until completion or existing timeout/retry behavior.
Version metadata refresh and optional external count_tokens still use startup proxy snapshots.
The network settings UI omits an empty password field, retaining the existing password even when the proxy address changes.
Future deployment must preserve the current 8993 rollback baseline rather than reintroduce unrelated local HEAD changes.
